reviews.body: Simplified the code and added a little detail to the changelog snippet

comments.body: @pcbeingused333 - Tests are failing. Please re-pull the PR branch and fix.

Thanks @ksylvan. The failing check was `TestValidateImageFile` in `internal/cli`: it uses fixed `/tmp/test.*` paths, and another test package writes `/tmp/test.txt` in parallel, so it failed with "image file already exists". ea9db8b0 moves those tests to a private temp dir; `go test ./internal/cli ./internal/server` passes with those files present, and the recovery tests are unaffected.
